mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.customer_name AS customerName, c.electricity_category AS electricityCategory, c.address, c.contact, c.electricity_status AS electricityStatus, m.id AS meterId, m.model, m.meter_status AS meterStatus, m.install_date AS meterInstallDate FROM electricity_customer c LEFT JOIN smart_meter m ON c.id = m.customer_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0

SELECT FROM electricity_customer
deleted = 0
AND customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%')
AND electricity_category = #{electricityCategory}
AND electricity_status = #{electricityStatus}
AND contact LIKE CONCAT('%', #{contact}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCustomers, SUM(CASE WHEN electricity_category = '居民' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS residential, SUM(CASE WHEN electricity_category = '商业' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS commercial, SUM(CASE WHEN electricity_category = '工业' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS industrial, SUM(CASE WHEN electricity_category = '农业' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS agricultural, SUM(CASE WHEN electricity_status = '正常用电' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active, SUM(CASE WHEN electricity_status = '暂停' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paused, SUM(CASE WHEN electricity_status = '销户' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed FROM electricity_customer WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT electricity_category AS category, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN electricity_status = '正常用电' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeCount FROM electricity_customer WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY electricity_category ORDER BY count ASC
